title: What The Silence Knows — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 94bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal music philosophy Spanish French language learning family Wilma
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The silence is not empty — that's the first mistake you make
It's full of what was said before and what will follow in its wake
The silence between two people is the record of their shared
History playing back at a frequency that can't be declared

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
El silencio no está vacío — ese es el primer error que cometes
[The silence is not empty — that's the first mistake you make]
Está lleno de lo que se dijo antes y de lo que sigue sin metes
[It's full of what was said before and what follows without entering]
El silencio entre dos personas es el registro de su historia
[The silence between two people is the record of their history]
Reproduciéndose en una frecuencia que no puede tener memoria
[Playing back at a frequency that cannot have memory]

[Chorus — English]
What does the silence know that I don't know?
It knows the things that didn't need to be said in the flow
What does the silence know in the space between the notes?
It knows that music needs the rest as much as it needs the throats
That's my boy

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
Le silence n'est pas vide — c'est la première erreur que tu fais
[The silence is not empty — that's the first mistake you make]
Il est plein de ce qui a été dit et de ce qui vient après
[It is full of what was said and what comes after]
Le silence entre deux personnes est le disque de leur histoire
[The silence between two people is the record of their history]
Se rejouant à une fréquence qui ne peut pas avoir de mémoire
[Playing back at a frequency that cannot have memory]

[Outro — All three languages]
What the silence knows… Lo que sabe el silencio… Ce que sait le silence
The rest is the music too — El descanso también es música — Le silence aussi est musique
That's my boy
